item: sqlcipher3 gets a ceiling below 0.6.4 until SQLCipher 4.19 is qualified
summary: sqlcipher3 0.6.4 (SQLCipher 4.19) reports page damage differently than 4.12 and reddened tests/test_poisoned_connection.py (8) and tests/test_database_verify_pages.py (21) in every lane that installs unpinned, main included; pyproject now caps at <0.6.4 with the measured reason, the registry and the maintenance doc record it, a test pins pyproject to the registry, and the qualification of 0.6.4 is an OPEN_QUEUE entry (no test was loosened)
